تقترحوا (form VIII)
# تَقْتَرِحُوا (taqtariḥū) /taq.ta.ri.ħuː/: second-person masculine plural non-past active subjunctive/jussive of اِقْتَرَحَ (iqtaraḥa)
# تُقْتَرَحُوا (tuqtaraḥū) /tuq.ta.ra.ħuː/: second-person masculine plural non-past passive subjunctive/jussive of اِقْتَرَحَ (iqtaraḥa)
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
